title: Portal access
description: Invite a payer to manage the household, or give an adult access to their own profile. Member-only access requires a date of birth showing they are at least 18.
invitationEmail: Your gym has invited you to its member portal. Open this private link to accept your invitation. It expires in seven days.
failed: We couldn't update portal access. Check the details and try again.
confirmRevoke: Revoke this login's access to the household?
awaitingHelp: This household joined online with this email address, and password logins can't prove who owns it. Check the person, then print a payer invitation for them; they set their password from it.
noAddress: The household has no email address.
pendingFailed: We couldn't load the outstanding invitations.
pendingHelp: Nobody has this access until they accept. Revoke an invitation to make its link stop working.
confirmWithdraw: Revoke this invitation? Its link will stop working.
